text: The Corporations Nominating Panel will consider the appointment of the new President and Chief Executive Officer of Tourism Toronto to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board.

City Council on January 29, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Scott Beck, President and Chief Executive Officer of Tourism Toronto to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending July 16, 2022 and until a successor is appointed. 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 7, 2020) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about an identifiable individual being considered for appointment to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board.
